subject: Identical command mirt(data, 1, "gpcm") leads do different results.

messages.author: de27f9442af7f7c0
messages.subject: Identical command mirt(data, 1, "gpcm") leads do different results.
parts:
Hello everybody,

Does anyone have an idea why it appears that the absolute identical command x<-mirt(data, 1, "gpcm") yields slightly different results regarding model parameter estimations (tries also differ in numer of iterations needed for estimation) every time I run it?

The same data set does not lead to inconsistent results when conducting graded response models.

I already tried it with set.seed(1) but this had no effect.

My data set: 20 variables with different number of response categories (2 to 6), 8000 responders, incomplete block-design: all participants answered at least 3 items, none answered the full item set, more than 3000 persons responded to at least 15  items.


I'm looking forward to your answers!

Thank you in advance for your support
Gregor
